chunks: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ has been transmitted by me from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Abān, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ.

key_terms.فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ: Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, a transmitter in the chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for narrations from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the precise line of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying the source and evaluating the report.
